subject: [PATCH v5 2/4] firmware: arm_sdei: add SDEI_EVENT_SIGNAL support

2026-07-09.patch_summary: This patch series adds support for the SDEI_EVENT_SIGNAL call, which signals a software-signalled event to another PE in an NMI-like manner. The patch introduces a new function sdei_event_signal() that wraps the SDEI_EVENT_SIGNAL call and is safe to call from NMI or crash context.
